criteria.criterion: solution/reference.py exposes build_update_rule(shape, hyper) returning an object with step(params, grads, state).
The reference step is a pure function of its arguments: no clock, no random source, no environment read, no network.
The reference's probe signature clears every pinned corpus entry by more than the bound behavioural margin, on the probe set the admin plane names.
Two probe passes over the reference produce identical transcripts and identical digests.
The reference changes only the update rule, its schedule, its state initialization and its hyperparameters, and touches no frozen axis.
Driven through the real gate chain on the clean fixture, the reference reaches exactly 1.0.
